body_lead: CHENNAI: The Tamil Nadu registration department recorded a revenue collection of Rs 1,950 crore for the month of October 2026, marking an increase of Rs 147 crore compared to the Rs1,803 crore collected during the same month last year. Minister for commercial taxes and registration D Logesh Tamilselvan chaired a state-level monthly performance review meeting on Wednesday and directed officials to plug revenue leakages and ensure that the department meets its annual fiscal targets.
